title: Claude Opus 4.7, GPT-5.4 Mini and Claude Haiku 4.5 Edit Other Providers' Documents Most Like Their Own Models
title_lines: Claude Opus 4.7, GPT-5.4 Mini and Claude Haiku 4.5 Edit Other Providers' Documents Most Like Their Own Models
notes: Whiskers: 95% bootstrap interval (blocks of rounds resampled within each run)

Distance: how differently a model edits another provider's document than that provider's own models do (judge score and five conflict metrics), averaged over the three other providers' documents. Dashed line: typical distance between a provider's own models. Home-like means editing like the developer's own models, not faithfulness to the document. Cross-edit; three-grader majority-vote codes.
